scope: All 10 performed web-tool calls in this agent's Desk1 specification search, including 23 exact submitted search queries and retained unsuccessful operations. No new search was run while writing this ledger.
capture_id_policy: Local capture IDs identify these recorded operations. Source URLs and page/line locators identify evidence; capture IDs are not publisher-issued identifiers.
query_results_policy: Queries batched in one web call returned one combined result set; per-query hit attribution and per-query wall time were not exposed and remain unknown. Incidental retailer/nonprimary results were not promoted to accepted dimension evidence.
budget_note: No finite search-call/query cap was registered before these calls. The completed observed count is bounded at 10 calls / 23 queries; this is accounting, not a retrospectively claimed preregistration.
